summary: OpenAI published a case study describing how Nextdoor's engineering team uses Codex (with GPT-5.4/5.5) to shift toward agent-driven, outcome-oriented software development.

practices.reason: The customer describes a mindset shift toward 'outcome engineering' with an agent but gives no concrete, implementable method or measured gain.
practices.quote: away from iteratively prompting an agent, and towards outcome engineering, where engineers start to think about the result they want to see and work with an agent to engineer that result.

practices.reason: The customer's own qualitative account of Codex's debugging persistence is an internal, unreplicated observation rather than a transferable measurement method.
practices.quote: We see Codex excel at being extremely persistent and trying to figure out the right solution, diving deep into some seemingly esoteric technical details to arrive at the root cause
